children.content: When the daemon isn't up yet the session list just shows an error. Make it retry first.

children.name: Paragraph
children.content: Done. The session list now retries twice before showing the error, and a slow earlier attempt can't overwrite a newer one.

children.name: Paragraph
children.content: Can the retry wait a bit longer between tries? It gives up before the daemon has finished starting.

children.name: Paragraph
children.content: The retry uses a fixed 200 ms pause. The daemon's own start-up takes about a second, so I'll switch to a growing pause and keep the test clock driving it.
